operation.summary: Read an existing applet JPEG using a photo URL from data; never captures a new photo. Control agents can read all saved applet photos; other principals only photos linked in accessible tables

query.name: offset
query.description: Optional byte offset for a large-photo chunk, at least 0

query.name: length
query.description: Chunk byte length, 1-8388608; default 8388608 with offset. Omit both for a whole JPEG up to 20 MB

operation.returns: image/jpeg (whole photo) or application/octet-stream (chunk with X-Bridgit-Photo-Offset/Total/Next headers); authenticate with the same Bearer key, never put the key in the URL
